publication_state: Public photo masters, unretouched gallery copies and enhanced alternatives are included in the GitHub repository update. Channel-specific exports remain local.
photographed_component_version: Not independently established from the photographs.
physical_evidence_scope: User-supplied photographs show a physical print closed and open with three SSDs; no measurements, endurance or thermal results are inferred.
originals_policy: Untouched HEIC originals are retained locally inside previews/photos/originals and specifically ignored by Git because they include GPS location. Public full-resolution JPEGs have location metadata removed without modifying decoded pixels.
